subject.summary: The US O*NET51-9041.00 covers setting up, operating, or tending machines such as glass forming machines, plodders, and tubers to form products such as glassware, food, rubber, soap, brick and tile, clay, wax, tobacco, or cosmetics. Official tasks include parameter and material control, measuring and weighing, gauge monitoring, handling jams and defective products, and production records; installing parts and disassembly and repair are supplementary items in the task set, and not every position performs all tasks.
